fullPassage: It was early October, and the weather couldn't have been better for hiking. Ryan slowly followed the mountain path, listening to the soft sounds of the forest around him. The afternoon sunlight felt warm on his skin, and he paused now and then, enjoying the quiet peace of being alone. Leaves moved lightly in the gentle wind, and he felt pleased far away from his usual worries. Then, he heard a strange sound behind him. He turned quickly and looked around. He didn't see anything, but he was certain he had heard something. And it wasn't the blowing of the wind or the falling of a twig. Someone — or something — was moving nearby. A sudden chill went through him, and his heart began beating fast.

questions.passage: Ryan slowly followed the mountain path, listening to the (A)[soft / harsh] sounds of the forest. The afternoon sunlight felt (B)[warm / cold] on his skin. He felt (C)[pleased / worried] far away from his usual worries.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 정답: 부드러운 소리 + 따뜻한 햇살 + 만족한 기분 — 평온한 시작
❌ ② harsh: 부드러운 숲소리와 반대
❌ ③ cold: 따뜻한 오후 햇살과 반대
❌ ④ worried: 걱정에서 벗어난 만족감과 반대
det.tip: 평온한 하이킹: soft + warm + pleased (나중에 두려움으로 변화)

questions.passage: Ryan heard a (A)[strange / familiar] sound behind him. He turned (B)[quickly / slowly] and looked around. He was (C)[certain / uncertain] he had heard something.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 정답: 낯선 소리에 빠르게 돌아보고 확신함
❌ ② familiar: 낯선 소리이므로 반대
❌ ③ slowly: 두려움에 빠르게 돌아봄
❌ ④ uncertain: 확실히 들었다고 확신함
det.tip: strange sound + turned quickly + certain = 두려움의 시작

questions.passage: It wasn't the blowing of the wind or the falling of a (A)[twig / branch]. Someone — or something — was moving (B)[nearby / far away]. A sudden (C)[chill / warmth] went through him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 정답: 잔가지가 아닌 다른 소리 + 근처에서 움직임 + 갑작스러운 오한
❌ ②③④: 맥락에 맞지 않음
det.tip: twig(잔가지) + nearby(근처에) + chill(오한) = 두려움 절정

questions.passage: Ryan slowly followed the mountain path, ①<u>listening</u> to the soft sounds of the forest. The afternoon sunlight felt ②<u>warm</u> on his skin. He felt ③<u>pleased</u> far away from his usual worries. Then, he heard a ④<u>familiar</u> sound behind him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ familiar → strange: 낯선 소리에 두려움을 느낌
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 정답: 낯선(strange) 소리를 들음 — familiar(익숙한)는 반대
❌ ①②③: 모두 평온한 하이킹 표현으로 정상
det.tip: strange sound(낯선 소리) = 두려움의 시작 ↔ familiar(익숙한)

questions.passage: He paused now and then, enjoying the ①<u>quiet</u> peace of being alone. Leaves moved ②<u>lightly</u> in the gentle wind. He ③<u>turned</u> quickly when he heard the strange sound. A sudden chill went through him, and his heart began beating ④<u>slowly</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ slowly → fast: 두려움에 심장이 빠르게 뜀
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 정답: chill + fear → heart beat fast — slowly는 반대
❌ ①②③: 모두 정상
det.tip: 두려움 반응: heart beat fast ↔ slowly

det.korean: ④ away → nearby: 근처에서 무언가가 움직이는 것
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 정답: 근처에서(nearby) 움직이는 것이 두려움을 유발 — away(멀리)는 반대
❌ ①②③: 모두 정상
det.tip: nearby(근처에) = 두려움의 원인 ↔ away(멀리)

questions.passage: He was __________ he had heard something. And it wasn't the blowing of the wind or the falling of a twig.

questions.passage: A sudden __________ went through him, and his heart began beating fast.

❌ ① warmth: 따뜻함 — 평온한 상황의 감각
❌ ② joy: 기쁨 — 두려움과 반대 감정
❌ ④ relief: 안도 — 두려움과 반대
det.tip: a sudden chill = 갑작스러운 오한 (두려움의 신체 표현)

he paused now and then, enjoying the quiet peace

det.analysis:

❌ ④ 뒤돌아보다: 다른 행동
